Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: In the spring and early summer, bears often scratch their backs against trees to remove winter fur. This is an example of an animal
A. completing its life cycle
B. beginning hibernation
C. responding to its environment
D. preparing for migration
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
